# Prepare and manage a temporary cross-border worker posting

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

A reviewed posting plan with applicable host-country notifications, social-security evidence and assignment completion records.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source checked on 2026-11-01. No case-specific legal review, independent professional assurance or completed execution is claimed. Sources establish regional entry points; determine the actual applicable local route with qualified reviewers.

- Sources: [Your Europe posting staff abroad](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/hiring-managing-staff/cross-border-posted-workers/posting-staff-abroad/index_en.htm)

## Outcomes

- A reviewed posting plan with applicable host-country notifications, social-security evidence and assignment completion records.

## Before you start

| Information to gather | Required by the record |
| --- | --- |
| Before temporarily sending an employee to perform work in another country, and when assignment facts change. | Yes |

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Record sending and host-country assignment facts

agent-runnable


Collect sending employer, host recipient, worker citizenship and residence, habitual work location, destination, duties, duration and previous assignments. Identify intermediaries and private contract evidence; do not classify a posting solely from a travel booking.

- Sources: [Your Europe posting staff abroad](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/hiring-managing-staff/cross-border-posted-workers/posting-staff-abroad/index_en.htm)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Review posting, immigration, tax and social security

human · human approval every run · hard to undo


Qualified local reviewers determine the applicable posting, host employment, immigration, payroll-tax and social-security routes for the actual worker and countries. A social-security certificate does not establish permission to work or settle the host-country employment requirements.

- Sources: [Your Europe posting staff abroad](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/hiring-managing-staff/cross-border-posted-workers/posting-staff-abroad/index_en.htm)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the reviewed assignment dossier

agent-runnable


Prepare the assignment terms, host contact, approved pay and working conditions, notification inputs and social-security application evidence. Record deadlines and required documents under the reviewed country instructions and flag missing employee or host information.

- Sources: [Your Europe posting staff abroad](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/hiring-managing-staff/cross-border-posted-workers/posting-staff-abroad/index_en.htm)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve the assignment and external applications

human · human approval every run · hard to undo


The accountable people owner approves the exact assignment and reviewed notification and application routes. Stop travel or work authorization where prerequisite review or evidence is missing; an internal assignment letter does not replace required external permission.

- Sources: [Your Europe posting staff abroad](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/hiring-managing-staff/cross-border-posted-workers/posting-staff-abroad/index_en.htm)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Complete authorized notifications and verify readiness

human · human approval every run · hard to undo


The authorized operator completes required host notifications and social-security or immigration applications through the applicable authorities. Retain accepted certificates and case references, check their coverage against the assignment, and escalate refusals before work begins.

- Sources: [Your Europe posting staff abroad](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/hiring-managing-staff/cross-border-posted-workers/posting-staff-abroad/index_en.htm)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Monitor changes and reconcile the posting end

agent-runnable


Track actual locations, duties and dates against the approved plan and certificate scope. Have the owner review extensions or changed facts, complete required closure updates and reconcile payroll and host records; retain the assignment evidence in the private company system.

- Verify: A reviewed posting plan with applicable host-country notifications, social-security evidence and assignment completion records.
- Sources: [Your Europe posting staff abroad](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/hiring-managing-staff/cross-border-posted-workers/posting-staff-abroad/index_en.htm)
